subject: phoenix
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: phoenix with flame plumage, wings spread.
Style: Genshin Impact.
reasoning:
I'm planning out a phoenix design with spread wings in a Genshin-style cel toon look, deciding whether it should stand grounded with legs and outstretched wings or appear mid-flight, while keeping the model reasonably efficient and ensuring it stays correctly positioned at ground level.

Now I'm sketching the skeleton structure—setting up a root hip joint and a spine chain using catmull curves running from hips to chest to neck, figuring out parenting so the chain connects properly to the root joint rather than creating a separate floating root.

Still defining the joint hierarchy...

Still defining beak spikes and jaw joint placement...

For the body, I'm binding the sweep path to hip, spine, and neck joints, then coloring it with a cel-shaded gradient paint that transitions from deep red at the back to orange and yellow toward the chest. I'm also working out the radius profile along the body curve to give it natural bulk.

Now I'm defining the head as a scaled sphere attached to the head bone, planning to add eyes via a decal placed on the head's surface using spherical coordinates for positioning.

For the crest, I'm sweeping several bezier-curved flame shapes back from the top of the head with varying heights and colors. For the wings, I'm chaining bones (shoulder, elbow, wrist, tip) outward and upward from the shoulder joint, building a catmull-rom curve through points that flare out to each side...

Now I'm figuring out the joint naming convention with left/right suffixes, then working on placing flight feathers along the wing arm as small extruded leaf-shaped blades fanning outward from each joint.

Defining feather color gradients...

Defining feather positions...

Still shaping feather geometry... I'm planning the tail next: seven long flowing streamers curving from the rump down and back, kept slightly above ground level for a flame-like drooping effect.

Defining the tail feather fan, computing lateral spread and curve points for seven plumes with varying tip positions and colors.

Setting up gradient ramps from crimson to gold, body countershading from crimson back to golden belly, and leg limb targets...

Building leg geometry with hip-knee-ankle chains and toe spike positions...

Now I'm adding glow effects selectively—crest flame sweeps can glow since glow needs flat colors not paint textures, and I'm planning a chest emblem decal styled after a Pyro flame symbol, positioned using a surface-hit calculation on the body mesh to find the correct front placement.

Skipping wingtip spikes and feather glow. I'll add gold bracer rings on the wing arms, plus brow ridge and cheek feather tufts as small swept-back spikes near the head, and a neck ruff made of a ring of spikes placed along the neck chain with an outward tilt.

Setting up eye colors (amber-red iris for the phoenix) and figuring out head decal placement using spherical coordinates for azimuth and elevation. Now I'm writing the feather placement code...

Still defining feather extrusion...

Defining color ramp logic...

Adding more bone chains...
